panels.description: Alex pushes Lock's assignment document back across the registry table. Ada watches, tense but still; leave upper space.
Lock opens four contributor files on the terminal: Lina Vey, Suri Anik, Jalen Orr and Ren Okafor. Keep the display unobstructed.
Alex folds the contributor list into his pocket. Keep his hand and the names clear.
Alex adds his own name to the corner of the list with a registry stylus. Leave upper space for his line.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: I’m not signing people I haven’t met.
